name: kpi-tracker
description: Internal KPI tracker: CRUD KPIs, Views, and access to Views.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
